description: This file defines API endpoint routes for user-related operations such as retrieving current user info, managing user profiles, and admin actions like listing users, activating/deactivating users, and changing user roles. It uses FastAPI for route definitions and database helper functions for data access.

methods.name: get_me(user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the basic information of the authenticated user.

methods.name: get_my_profile(user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Fetches the profile of the authenticated user from the database.

methods.name: update_my_profile(update: ProfileUpdate, user: dict = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates or creates the profile for the authenticated user based on provided data.

methods.name: list_users(_: dict = Depends(require_admin))
methods.description: Lists all users in the system (admin only).

methods.name: set_active(user_id: int, active: bool, _: dict = Depends(require_admin))
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a user account (admin only).

methods.name: change_role(user_id: int, role: str, _: dict = Depends(require_admin))
methods.description: Changes the role of a user between 'user' and 'admin' (admin only).

ctags.name: change_role
ctags.pattern: /^def change_role(user_id: int, role: str, _: dict = Depends(require_admin)):$/

ctags.name: set_active
ctags.pattern: /^def set_active(user_id: int, active: bool, _: dict = Depends(require_admin)):$/
